title.zh: Sing-box 与 Clash 订阅格式无损互转实战：解析 JSON 配置与 YAML 规则的映射机制
title.en: Lossless Sing-box & Clash Subscription Conversion: Mapping JSON Schemas to YAML Profiles

description.zh: 深入讲解如何将传统的 Clash YAML 订阅无损转换为 Sing-box JSON 格式。解析 Subconverter 在线与本地转换原理、节点加密参数映射、分流规则继承与自建转换后端防隐私泄露实践。
description.en: Master seamless conversion between Clash YAML and Sing-box JSON subscription profiles. Learn how Subconverter maps protocol parameters, transforms routing rules, and deploy a self-hosted conversion backend for maximum privacy.
